facts.fact: Tom Allen was described and advertised as a retired champion of the world from 1894 into 1895, and signed a December 1894 letter as "Retired Champion of the World".
Tom Allen was advertised as the retired champion pugilist of the world from June 1896 to March 1897.
Tom Allen was billed in advertisements and described in print as the retired champion pugilist of the world from 1898 to 1900.
In March and April 1903 Tom Allen was described as a retired champion pugilist living in St. Louis.
An estate inventory of Tom Allen's property, dated July 1903, listed a champion's cup.
